translation.name: Na Rongorongo Uto nina Jesus Christ

content.text: God, ko bei sopou beto mo ko [bei] hodo,
Ko bei kapu na mangamu.
Ko rongovira ghamua na kana tara gunaguna,
gaira tara nigho sika tara hughuhughu kolugho.
Gaira tara goni poloa siki totobo dika vanira kulamu na vure:
Mana palongira gaira to righitaonira ighoe.
Keri ge ra bosa mana ghaghua,
“Mai, ma kai durakea na kema ni Israel eni,
ma ka nia ponolio haliu tua.”
Gaira tara nia liosakai na ghanaghana keri;
ma ra gonidilaa ghamua na mate.
Na vure ni Edom mana kemana Ishmael,
na vure ni Moab mana kemana Hagri,
Na vure ni Gebal, Ammon, ma Amalek,
maia rana Philistia mi Tyre,
Assyria ghua te nira pala,
gaira didira na vure laga rana kemana Lot.
Ko nea vanira na hava to nea vanira rana kema ni Midian,
mi tana Sisera mana Jabin, tana beti tavetave i Kishon.
Gaira raini tara matehoru i Endor;
me kokovo horu ga na hulidira.
Ko nea vanira [tara hulira]/[rana vunaghidira],
na hava to nea vanira a Oreb ma Zeeb,
ko laga vulera tara hulira vaghaa
to nera igaa a Zebah ma Zalmunna,
Tara bosa mara ghaghua,
“Mai, ma ka holai dida nina bona lologho a God!”
God, ko havukaghinira vaghaa na pughu ni pari,
vaghara na vughevughe te vulo saghinira na ghuri.
Me vaghaa na lake te ghani taghalaghinia na leao,
ma na lapilapi ni lake te pisui na lei ghotu.
Vagha keri, ko ghurura nia ghua na maraghata!
mo ko lavi mataghuniadira nia na ghuri sule.
Keri vaho ge kara kene taonia na ahamu, Ighoe a Lord.
Sania, ma kara lagavulera ma kara mataghu haia tua:
ma kara mua nia tangomana siki totobo kara gonia.
Keri vaho ge kara ghilalagho,
ighoe heghemu vamua a Lord:
To vunaghi pungisia na maramana talighu.
